title: Live fixed-G1 barrier pin race · 2 workers
mission: Run the smallest real GitHub-backed end-to-end canary for the explicit contention barrier plus fixed-generation ownership path. Two distinct /wc workers must register as timing-only entrants before deadline, obtain one no-authority RELEASE, then race the same deterministic G000001. Exactly one worker wins execution authority; the loser writes one normal portfolio pin-collision receipt, creates no execution claim, and re-enters allocation. The winner may return DONE only after the required loser collision is durably visible; otherwise return PARTIAL without manufacturing G000002.
definition_of_done: Exactly two distinct entrant worker_ids exist before the barrier deadline.
Exactly one valid RELEASE exists with grants_execution_authority=false and next_action=RACE_DETERMINISTIC_PIN.
No G000001 PIN attempt occurs before valid RELEASE.
After RELEASE both entrants target the same deterministic G000001 and exactly one PIN wins.
Exactly one prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 loser receipt exists for attempted_generation=1 and that loser created no execution claim.
The authoritative winner return plus collision_count>=1 resolves fixed_generation_attention and no ordinary G000002 recovery is exposed.
Timeout without quorum produces no PIN attempt and no false completion.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.
